title: Password Security Analyzer
desc: A real-time password strength analysis tool that evaluates password security using entropy calculation, pattern detection, and common password checks. It provides instant feedback, estimated crack time, and actionable suggestions to improve password strength. Built with a privacy-first approach where all analysis happens locally in the browser.
tech: Python · JavaScript · HTML & CSS · Zxcvbn · GitHub

title: ThreatLens - Reconstruct the invisible
desc: A browser-based SOC dashboard that reconstructs cyber attacks by mapping security events across the Cyber Kill Chain and the MITRE ATT&CK framework. It analyzes raw security logs using a client-side rule engine, automatically identifies attack stages, enriches events with ATT&CK techniques, and calculates dynamic risk scores to help analysts understand attacker behavior. Designed as a lightweight, privacy-friendly platform with no backend or AI API dependencies.
tech: TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind CSS · JavaScript · HTML · CSS
